rationale: Refs #468. Extend existing publication lookup with optional strict original source artifact verification for the forthcoming customer adapter. No new capability or product-specific logic.
supersession_impact: No existing capability retired. Offline artifact-only tests retain their existing contract; customer integration must explicitly enable strict verification.
authority_impact: No expansion or relaxation of authority. Strict lookup rejects missing or mismatched source bytes before existing publication admission; no change to publication or certification gates.
